_doc: Media for the landing page. Paths are relative to /media/<theme>/. Each entry is a filename or a list tried in order (video first, then still). Missing files fall back to a gradient + the animated overlay. Hero: 16:9 video (1920x1080, muted loop) + poster. Stages: 16:9 stills 1376x768 (.webp) or short muted loops (.mp4).
